text:
Emily (People Ops): Hi team — quick heads up: I need to move my parental leave start from 2027-07-12 to 2027-07-19 due to a scheduling conflict with the clinic. Can someone confirm what paperwork I need to update and whether payroll/top-up deadlines are affected? Also need help coordinating on-call coverage for my final two weeks.

Sam (Eng Manager): Congrats! You just need to update the start date in the HR leave portal and attach the latest physician note. I can take on-call for the critical nights but need a simple handoff doc — can you drop it by EOD Friday?

Raj (People Ops): Hi @Emily — checklist for a date change: 
- Update the leave request in the HR portal: https://hr.redwood.example/leave 
- Upload the physician confirmation PDF to the request 
- Submit the pay top-up form if you want company top-up (deadline = 10 business days before new start) at /forms/leave-topup 
- We can file FMLA/state leave on your behalf if you want — reply "yes" and we will initiate.

peopleops_bot: Reminder: leave request missing required attachment. Please upload doctor_note.pdf within 72 hours to avoid processing delay.

Emily (People Ops): Thanks @Raj — please file FMLA for me. I'll upload the doc this morning. Also thinking about a phased return (20 hrs/week for 6 weeks) — what is the process for requesting that?

Raj (People Ops): For phased returns, submit the 'Reduced Hours / Phased Return' addendum in the portal after the main leave is approved. Use code PHASED-20 in the comments so Benefits can flag it. We'll coordinate payroll adjustments and confirm the effective dates with your manager.

Sam (Eng Manager): For the handoff, here's a short template you can paste into a doc — feel free to fill owners next to items and I'll redistribute:
```
Handoff checklist:
- Active PRs + owner
- On-call runbook + escalation steps
- Critical cron jobs/dashboards
- Scheduled releases during leave window (owner)
- Pager rotation for weeks 1-2
- Emergency contact / backup plan
```
If you indicate owners I'll set the rotation in the calendar.

Kim (SWE): I can take Mon/Wed on-call nights while you're out and pair on the runbook this week.

Emily (People Ops): Amazing, @Kim and @Sam — thank you. @Raj after FMLA is filed can you confirm payroll top-up timing and whether PTO needs to be used before the leave starts?

Raj (People Ops): Confirmed: payroll will process top-up if both the top-up form and physician note are submitted at least 10 business days before 2027-07-19 (the updated start). If you prefer to apply PTO before leave, mark those dates in the leave request; otherwise PTO remains available separately.

peopleops_bot: FMLA packet created and sent to emily@redwood.example. Tracking ID: FMLA-2027-089.

Emily (People Ops): Doc uploaded and tracker received — thanks. One more Q: is the company childcare stipend prorated for a partial-month/part-time return?

Raj (People Ops): Yes — we can prorate the stipend for partial months. Add "prorate childcare" to the portal comments and we'll apply the adjustment during benefits processing.

Sam (Eng Manager): I'll block a 1hr handoff on Thursday afternoon. Emily, can you put the calendar invite out?

Emily (People Ops): Scheduled. Thanks everyone :heart:

Kim (SWE): :thumbsup:
